dialogue.text:
I read an old document I found once,
said that originally the pins were meant to be stickers.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text: Bunch of research stuff, mostly uninteresting stuff.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text: There was never any mention of WHY they were changed to pins.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
The docs suddenly started referring to them as pins
without any reason.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text: Am sure it means nothing tho'.
dialogue.speaker: April
